title: Block Out Level 25 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 25 is a sandglass support puzzle with tall side rails. Open the white-and-black waist first, rotate the lower pink-cyan chamber second, and only then start spending the long framed side columns.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 25 is a sandglass support puzzle with tall side rails. Open the white-and-black waist first, rotate the lower pink-cyan chamber second, and only then start spending the long framed side columns.
landmarks: Block Out Level 25 is a sandglass support puzzle with tall side rails.
Open the white-and-black waist first, rotate the lower pink-cyan chamber second, and only then start spending the long framed side columns.
The board mixes Purple, Green, Pink and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Open the waist before touching the side rails.
The lower chamber needs room before the tall side columns can travel.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the white ladders and black blockers away from the sandglass neck.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Keep the long framed side columns parked while the upper choke is still narrow.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Once the waist opens, rotate the lower pink and cyan mass so the chamber stops pressing upward.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Feed one tall side column only after the lower chamber has created real empty space.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Use the new room to separate the second tall side column and the inner green strip.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the lower chamber before the last side column leaves.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: End with the remaining green route after the neck is completely open.

failurePoints: Trying to spend a side rail while the waist is still narrow.
Ignoring the lower chamber and overfocusing on the tall rails.
